slides.title: Welcome to Uniquem
slides.caption: Welcome to Uniquem. Safety is everyone's job here. Follow your manager's direction, and if you're ever unsure about a task, stop and ask.

slides.title: No smoking anywhere on Uniquem property
slides.caption: There is no smoking anywhere on Uniquem property, inside or outside, including the doors, loading docks, trailers and parking lot. Our products and their vapours can catch fire. Put it out, and only smoke off the property.

slides.title: Forklifts: make eye contact
slides.caption: When you see a forklift, stop and wait. Make eye contact with the driver before you move. Drivers stop and confirm they have seen you too.

quiz.q: You are not sure how to do a task on site. What should you do?
options: Work it out on your own
quiz.explanation: Always follow your manager's direction. When in doubt, stop and ask.

quiz.q: Where on Uniquem property is smoking allowed?
options: Outside by the warehouse back door
By the trailers at the loading dock
quiz.explanation: No smoking anywhere on Uniquem property, inside or out. Put it out and only smoke off the property.

quiz.q: A forklift is coming toward you in the warehouse. What do you do?
options: Stop, wait and make eye contact with the driver before you move
quiz.explanation: Stop and make eye contact so the driver knows you are there. Only move once the driver has stopped and seen you.

slides.title: Coveralls
slides.caption: Wear your coveralls, fully done up, in every work area. They keep chemicals off your skin and your own clothes.

slides.title: Masks, respirators and ventilation
slides.caption: Open drums and blending can release dust and vapours. Wear the mask or respirator the task calls for, and keep the area ventilated. Drag to turn the drum.

slides.title: Ear protection
slides.caption: Pumps, compressors and mixers are loud. Wear ear plugs or ear muffs wherever hearing protection signs are posted.

quiz.q: When should your coveralls be worn?
options: In every work area, fully done up
quiz.explanation: Coveralls are worn in every work area so chemicals stay off your skin and clothes.

quiz.q: You are opening a drum and notice strong vapours. What helps protect you?
options: Your mask or respirator and good ventilation
quiz.explanation: Use the mask or respirator the task calls for and keep the area ventilated.

quiz.q: Where do you need ear protection?
options: Wherever hearing protection signs are posted, near pumps and mixers
quiz.explanation: Loud equipment damages hearing over time. Wear plugs or muffs where signs are posted.
